title: Injury application leaves cached total incapacitation stale for later same-update combat consumers
classification: source-confirmed consequence/cache ordering defect; simultaneous gameplay occurrence not executed
producer_and_recipient: Condition updates cached total before pending contacts. Injury application then changes defender limbs, acute trauma and imbalance without updating total. Later same-update completion admission and performance use only cached total; readiness derives from that cache.
static_witness: Two due contacts processed after Condition can apply damage to an actor before another completion involving that actor. After first result, state.acute_trauma and limbs reflect injury but state.incapacitation remains pre-hit. Subsequent guard/performance therefore observes old total until next Condition. Threshold crossing is one consequence, but stale performance exists for any nonzero added total. No simulated fight or deterministic test run.
normal_qualification: One next Condition recomputes all sources, so this is bounded between updates/contacts. charge_work explicitly maintains total atomically for fatigue changes, and does not establish injury synchronization. Event order/due contact construction traced; no assertion every fight has simultaneous due contacts or observed exploit.
connected_repair: Make consequence application coordinate injury/trauma/imbalance and derived total before any subsequent authority/performance consumer, using one canonical calculation and necessary limb/will/blood state. Keep transient Bevy authority, do not persist tactical tick state or create a second readiness boolean.
acceptance: After accepted injury/imbalance consequence, all later same-update authority and performance reads agree with canonical source total; crossing cutoff prevents next ordinary action. Preserve limb-specific injury intent, fatigue charge, wheel100percent cutoff, and one general fatigue contribution.
dedup: Distinct from Native05F029 raw public fatigue/total mutation and root M89 injury unit propagation; coordinator previously found no exact same-tick alias. Global union pending.
